_about: Battle Brothers weapons copied exactly from the wiki text in the repo (rule 63d); every row cites its page. Rows = every weapon in the class tables of the Melee Weapons and Ranged Weapons pages (Daggers, Swords, Maces, Spears, Axes, Flails, Cleavers, Hammers, Polearms, Bows, Crossbows, Firearms, Throwing Weapons, Throwable Items), one row per weapon (a weapon listed on two class pages keeps the first and names the other in also_listed_in); named, legendary and unique items left out (see _excluded). Numbers come from the class table; the weapon's own page infobox fills blanks, and where the two disagree both are kept in conflicts. Worth written as 2.600 on a weapon page is the same number as 2600 on the class table. fatigue on a weapon = its Max. Fatigue penalty; fatigue on a skill = fatigue built per use. armor_damage_pct = Vs. Armor, armor_ignore_pct = Ignores Armor. Skills are the weapon page's Skills section, each looked up on its own skill page (AP, fatigue, description). hit_bonus = the base chance-to-hit modifier the skill page states, null if it states none (per-tile and adjacent-target penalties stay in effect). Wiki notes that apply to every row: 'A hit to the head with any weapon causes 50% additional damage to HP, but not to the armor.' 'Orc Weapons require 5 additional fatigue points per skill use for humans.' (Melee Weapons page). null plus missing[] wherever the sources do not give a value.
